context: Ren and Asuka discuss research design.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: research discussion; vocabulary (含む/単位/基づい/主体/想定) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 調査は、何に基づいて設計しますか?
lines.en: What do we base the survey design on?
lines.style: engaged young student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 過去のデータに基づいて、設計します。
lines.en: We design based on past data.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 対象には、誰を含むんですか?
lines.en: Whom do we include as subjects?
lines.style: curious young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 若者を主体に、幅広く含みます。
lines.en: We include broadly, with youth as the main focus.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 人数の単位は、どう決めますか?
lines.en: How do we decide the unit of participants?
lines.style: engaged young student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 百人を一単位として、想定します。
lines.en: We assume a hundred as one unit.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 想定外のことも、起きますか?
lines.style: thoughtful young student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 想定を超える発見が、研究の醍醐味です。
lines.en: Findings beyond expectation are research's joy.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
